title: 八上 · 信息组织与合作训练卷
scope: 动词搭配、构词与词性、主旨和推断、合作通知写作；原创笔试能力训练。
language: g-transitivity
We reached [[1]] before the doors opened.
the museum
to the museum
at the museum
reach 在这里直接接地点宾语 the museum。
reach 后不再加 to；不能照搬 go to 的结构。
reach 后不再加 at；不能照搬 arrive at 的结构。
g-indefinites
I have [[1]] to tell you about the project.
something useful
useful something
something usefully
形容词 useful 修饰不定代词 something 时通常后置。
修饰 something 的形容词不能这样前置。
这里需形容词 useful，而非副词 usefully。
g-derivation
The students made a careful [[1]] before choosing a design.
comparison
compare
comparatively
a careful 后需要名词，comparison 表比较。
compare 是动词，不能直接作这里的名词中心语。
comparatively 是副词，不符合此处名词位置。
g-double-objects
表达“替我买”：Can you buy a notebook [[1]] me?
for
to
from
buy something for somebody 表为某人买某物。
不能把 give ... to ... 的结构套到此处 buy 上。
from me 表向我购买，改变了为我买的意思。
g-questions
'[[1]] do you practise the dialogue?' 'Twice a week.'
How often
How long
How far
Twice a week 回答频率，用 How often。
How long 问持续时间，不是每周次数。
How far 问距离，不是频率。
g-adjectives
The instructions are [[1]] enough for new members to follow.
clear
clearly
clearness
are 后描述说明文字的状态，用形容词 clear。
clearly 是副词，不能作这里所需的形容词表语。
clearness 是名词，不符合此处 clear enough 的结构。
g-adverbs
The new helper checked the labels [[1]].
carefully
careful
care
空格修饰 checked 这一动作，用副词 carefully。
careful 是形容词，不能在这里修饰 checked。
care 在这里不能作修饰 checked 的副词。
g-verb-forms
Please [[1]] the broken parts in this tray.
leave
left
leaving
Please 引出的请求用动词原形 leave。
left 是过去式或过去分词，不适合这里的祈使句。
leaving 不能独立作这一请求的谓语。

cloze.text: Our group made a guide for a school exhibition. We knew the objects well, so our first guide used many long 〔1〕_____. When a younger class tried it, several students stopped after the first paragraph. We wanted to add more facts, but our teacher asked us to 〔2〕_____ the visitors first. One student said she could understand the words but did not know where to start. We changed the guide into three short steps and put a small 〔3〕_____ beside each object to show the order. The next group found its way without asking us for help. We kept the important facts, but made the 〔4〕_____ clearer. A guide is useful when it helps its readers do something, not just when it shows how much its writers 〔5〕_____.
items: sentences
silences
tickets
several students stopped after the first paragraph.
第一版文字冗长，长句使读者难以继续；后文改成短步骤。
silences 是沉默，不能构成这里的书面段落。
tickets 是票，不是指南中段落的语言形式。
listen to
compete with
hide from
One student said she could understand the words but did not know where to start.
先听使用者说明困难，才知道需要改的是起点和顺序。
与参观者竞争不能解释后文收集到他们的反馈。
躲开参观者就无法听到他们说哪里困惑。
number
price
meal
to show the order.
数字能指示参观顺序。
价格表示费用，不能在这里承担顺序标记的作用。
食物不能作为这里的编号。
organisation
weather
ownership
We changed the guide into three short steps
短步骤和编号改变的是信息组织方式。
天气并非指南改进的内容。
所有权并没有因改写步骤而改变。
know
buy
borrow
We kept the important facts
结尾对比帮助读者与炫示作者知道多少事实。
原文没有以购物数量衡量作者。
原文也没有比较借用了多少东西。

reading.text:
BORROW A TOOL KIT
The design room now has three small tool kits for class projects. A student may borrow one kit for up to two school days. Ask your class teacher to sign the request card, then take it to the design-room desk. The desk is open at lunchtime, not after school. Before leaving, check the list inside the kit with the helper. Report anything missing at once. On return, put the kit on the desk so a helper can check it again. Do not put it straight into the cupboard. If you need more time, ask before the return date. Another group may already be waiting for that kit.
items: What must happen before a kit can be collected?
A class teacher signs the request card.
A student waits outside after school.
A group buys its own cupboard.
Ask your class teacher to sign the request card
先请班主任在申请卡上签字，再到设计室领取。
领取桌只在午间开放，不能据此选择放学后等候。
购置柜子不是借用条件。
Why should students check the kit with a helper before leaving?
To identify missing items immediately.
To choose a new class teacher.
To avoid returning the kit.
Report anything missing at once.
共同核对清单能及时发现和报告缺件。
清单检查不涉及选择班主任。
借期和归还要求仍然存在，检查不免除归还。
What should a student do when returning the kit?
Leave it on the desk for another check.
Put it directly into the cupboard.
Keep it until no one asks about it.
put the kit on the desk so a helper can check it again.
归还后需再次核对，先放桌上。
原文明示不能直接放入柜子。
延长借期需提前询问，不能无限保留。
Why should a request for extra time be made before the return date?
Another group may be waiting to use the kit.
All kits are given away on that date.
The desk only opens after school.
Another group may already be waiting for that kit.
提前协调是因为同一工具可能还有下一组使用者。
文中没有到期赠送工具的规定。
开放时间是午间，选项把时间改成放学后。

reading.text: A class wanted to know whether pictures helped people sort classroom waste. On Monday, they put a poster with words above three bins. On Tuesday, they added pictures. Fewer items went into the wrong bin on Tuesday, so some students said the pictures had solved the problem. Their teacher asked what else was different. The students checked their notes. On Tuesday, two helpers stood beside the bins and answered questions. The class could not tell how much of the change came from the pictures alone. They decided to try again on two similar days, with no helpers on either day. Their first result was useful because it showed what they needed to check next.
items: What changed on Tuesday besides the poster?
Two helpers answered questions beside the bins.
The class removed all the bins.
The school stopped producing waste.
two helpers stood beside the bins and answered questions.
除图片外，还有现场帮助这一变化。
文中仍有分类箱，没有撤掉全部箱子。
少放错不等于不产生垃圾。
Why could the class not credit the pictures alone?
Help from the two students may also have affected sorting.
There were no notes from either day.
Pictures can never help with sorting.
The class could not tell how much of the change came from the pictures alone.
两个条件同时改变，不能只归因于图片。
他们正是检查笔记后发现还有帮助者。
一次不清楚的比较不能推出图片永远无效。
What would make their next comparison more useful?
Keeping the help conditions the same on both days.
Adding more new changes on the second day.
Throwing away all records.
with no helpers on either day.
两天都没有帮助者，能减少这项额外差异的影响。
额外改变更多条件会更难判断图片的作用。
删除记录会失去核对条件的依据。
What is the best main idea?
Check other changing conditions before explaining a result.
A good poster always needs three colours.
A first attempt must be thrown away if it is imperfect.
it showed what they needed to check next.
全文由初步判断转向核对条件，并用结果设计下一次比较。
文中没有比较三种颜色。
第一轮结果仍有帮助，并未被认定应全部丢弃。

task.text:
EXHIBITION TEAM MESSAGE
We will set up the class exhibition on Friday. The objects arrive at 13:40, but guides should come at 13:20 to check the route. Mei checks the wording of the labels. Arun asks the makers for permission to use their photographs. Both jobs must be finished before the exhibition opens at two. If permission is missing, leave that photograph out of the display.
items: Guides should arrive at _____. 用24小时制数字填写。
guides should come at 13:20 to check the route.
13:20是讲解员到场时间，13:40是展品到场时间。
Mei checks the _____ of the labels. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
wording
Mei checks the wording of the labels.
Mei负责核对标签文字，许可由Arun负责。
A photograph without _____ should not be displayed. 从原文中填一个英文单词。
permission
If permission is missing, leave that photograph out of the display.
未获得使用许可的照片应从展览中排除。

writing.stem: 为班级展览写一则约70—90词的英文通知。说明周五14:00开放、讲解员13:20到场检查路线；参展者核对标签文字并确认照片使用许可。邀请同学参观，同时提醒不要触碰展品。可合理补充细节，不写真实联系方式。
writing.model:
CLASS EXHIBITION
Our class exhibition opens at two on Friday afternoon. Everyone is welcome to visit and learn about our projects. Guides should arrive at twenty past one to check the route before visitors enter. If you are showing a project, please check the wording on its label and make sure you have permission to use any photographs. During the visit, please look carefully but do not touch the objects. We hope you enjoy sharing ideas with us.
points: 周五14:00开放，讲解员13:20到场检查路线
核对标签文字与照片使用许可
邀请参观并提醒不要触碰展品
writing.organisation: 先说明活动与时间，再给准备要求和参观提醒。
writing.language: 区分两类人员的到场时间；检查 should 后的原形、时间介词和请求语气。
writing.format: 通知有清楚标题，读者可直接找到行动信息
writing.pitfall: 不要把展品到场的13:40误写成讲解员到场时间。
